title: Beaten Biscuits
description: These beaten biscuits are an old Southern recipe featuring lard, low-gluten flour, and cream and can be made in a food processor for easy preparation.
ingredients: 0.25 cup lard, chilled and cut into small pieces

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Grease baking sheets.

Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt together in a large bowl. Use a fork to cut in lard until mixture resembles coarse meal. Using a standing mixer or a wooden spoon, mix dough as you slowly add cream. Mix well to form dough into a ball, adding cold water as needed.

Place dough onto a clean surface and knead slightly. Using a mallet or a one-piece rolling pin, beat dough a few times to form into a rough rectangle. Fold dough over, then beat it out again. Repeat this process until dough becomes white and blisters form on the surface, about 15 minutes.
Roll out dough to about 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into 2-inch rounds and prick the tops a few times with the tines of a fork. Place dough rounds on the prepared baking sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven until biscuits are golden, about 15 minutes.
